compound_ladder.label: calibrated (0.21% of lap time)
compound_ladder.derivation: fresh-tyre step prior 0.145 s (calibrated (0.21% of lap time)). The races identify the *net* cost of one step harder over a whole stint, holding stint length and race phase fixed: Spielberg 2025 -0.097 +/- 0.321 s [not used: standard error 0.321 s > 0.15 s (pre-2026 measurement, too imprecise to pool)]; australia-2026 +0.317 +/- 0.345 s; japan-2026 -0.069 +/- 0.664 s; barcelona-2026 +0.060 +/- 0.336 s; belgium-2026 +0.075 +/- 0.323 s; hungary-2026 -0.010 +/- 0.327 s; italy-2026 +0.173 +/- 0.354 s -> pooled +0.109 +/- 0.147 s per step. The model's fresh-tyre offsets are calibrated so that, with its own degradation ladder, it reproduces this net at the stint length it recommends.

explanation: OCO: 2-stop M-H-M @ 20,44; BEA: 2-stop M-H-M @ 20,44 - the same first stop (lap 20); the same plan shape
S3 degradation: OCO -0.0180 vs BEA -0.0903 s/lap of age (+0.0722); it says *where* the loss is, and enters no cost [OCO: n=10, w=0.45, team | BEA: n=14, w=0.54, driver]
S1 degradation: OCO -0.0747 vs BEA -0.0104 s/lap of age (-0.0642); it says *where* the loss is, and enters no cost [OCO: n=10, w=0.45, team | BEA: n=14, w=0.54, driver]

pace level: OCO 0.093 s/lap vs BEA -0.271 s/lap (+0.365); the quicker car reaches any given gap to the car ahead sooner, which moves the lap its stop is worth taking [OCO: n=11, w=0.58, driver | BEA: n=11, w=0.58, driver]

warm-up: OCO 0.77 s per stint vs BEA 1.27 s per stint (-0.503); a bigger warm-up cost makes every extra stop dearer, which pushes toward fewer stops and a later first one [OCO: n=1, w=0.00, team | BEA: n=2, w=0.40, team]

race-history rate factor (from previous races, not this weekend's evidence): OCO x1.055 vs BEA x1.190 after precision shrinkage (raw x1.092 / x1.323, ln_sd 0.07994876713617106 / 0.07804232306559754); it scales the whole rate, so the higher factor stops earlier

traffic sensitivity: OCO 1.11x vs BEA 0.74x (+0.376); the more traffic-sensitive car pays more for rejoining into the pack, which pushes its stop toward a clearer lap [OCO: n=1, w=0.00, team | BEA: n=3, w=0.33, team]
the two recommendations agree: the differences above are not big enough to separate the plans
